quote.text: But the wise man knows that all things are in store for him. Whatever happens, he says: "I knew it.
quote.author: Epictetus
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood
    • Embrace the unfolding of your child's growth, understanding that each challenge is a natural part of their journey and an opportunity for learning.
    • Develop patience and acceptance in nurturing them, confident that even unexpected moments contribute to the fabric of their character and your shared resilience.
  • Leadership
    • Accept that events within an organization will unfold beyond your control, and prepare your team to handle change with wisdom and composure.
    • Cultivate a mindset where foreseeing challenges allows you to navigate them proactively, inspiring trust and resilience in those who follow your guidance.
  • Product Management
    • Recognize that market dynamics and user feedback are inherently unpredictable, and plan your product strategy with both flexibility and insight.
    • Foster a culture of learning from every outcome, whether anticipated or not, so that each iteration of your product advances with wisdom and foresight.
